blocks.md: The thermal hangover refuted candidate (b) from a model, but a placement that survives every model still has to face a measurement that could refute it. A claim of silicon isolation between an unverified learned workload and a safety enforcer must therefore reduce to a testable bound on enforcement latency and refusal availability. This bound must hold across all declared proposal workloads, junction temperatures, and operational modes.

questions.q: The section **Empirical Verification of Silicon Isolation** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A refuted placement forces a remedy matched to the coupling (static reservation, spatial partitioning, separate silicon), each paid in a different currency and leaving a named residual.

The placement record binds the declared WCET and deadline to the execution domain, privilege, period, unloaded and loaded maxima, bus QoS, droop and thermal limits, mitigations, and the conditions left untested.

The exchange has two separately timed obligations (board-link transport, then one bounded local publication read inside the WCET), and liveness needs a windowed watchdog that catches early feeds as well as late ones.
Privilege checks govern digital access while the shared rail powers the gates that perform them, so droop, clock faults, and shared resets are failure domains beneath privilege.

points: **Worst-case execution time**: A declared upper execution-time bound for a specified binary and platform; observed maxima can falsify it but do not establish it.
